name: Multi-Agent Systems Assignment: Supervisor-Worker Pattern Demo

parameters.content:
## 🧠 SUPERVISOR AGENT

Receives the user task, decomposes it into sub-tasks, and routes to workers. Aggregates all results at the end.

## 👷 WORKER AGENTS

Three specialized agents, each with dedicated tools:
- 🔍 Research
- 📝 Summarize  
- ✅ Verify

They run sequentially here due to data dependencies.

## 📚 ASSIGNMENT MODULES

This workflow teaches:
1. Single vs Multi-Agent overview
2. Roles & Supervisor-Worker pattern
3. Messaging & delegation
4. Tools in agent systems
5. Live simulation (modules 5-7)
6. Coordination diagram
7. Hands-on exercise
